protocol.name: bsm_session_host_v1
protocol.description:
Private protocol between bsm (the Bingux Session Manager, acting as the system compositor) and the bridge of one hosted Gnoblin user session (`bsm-host`). It is advertised only on connections that bsm itself brokered for a session generation and verified (uid, systemd scope, executable path, pid). Greeter and unprivileged clients never see this global, and the session bridge never sees any other privileged global.
A hosted session presents one surface per bsm output. Surfaces are not xdg toplevels: bsm decides where they appear, whether they are visible and whether they receive input. Pixels travel as ordinary wl_buffers (wl_shm, later linux-dmabuf) attached to the wl_surface. Keyboard, pointer and touch events arrive through the ordinary wl_seat objects of the same connection while bsm routes input to this session; the bridge forwards them into the session's Gnoblin.

entry.name: gnoblin_ready
entry.summary: Gnoblin runtime handshake complete; session-local clients are served

entry.name: output_configured
entry.summary: virtual output for the named bsm output is configured

entry.name: bingux_launched
entry.summary: Bingux wallpaper and shell processes were launched

entry.name: surfaces_mapped
entry.summary: required Bingux surfaces mapped on an output (a mapped of b required)

entry.name: desktop_ready
entry.summary: Bingux declared its initial desktop ready

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: output already has a session surface

entry.name: stale_generation
entry.summary: generation does not match the current session

request.name: get_session_surface

description.summary: bind a wl_surface to an output of the session

request.description: Gives wl_surface the bsm_session_surface role for the named output. Only one surface per output and generation is allowed.

request.name: report

description.summary: report a startup milestone with evidence counts

request.description: The generation must match the one sent in the identity event; a stale report raises stale_generation. bsm validates reports against frames it actually received before it advances progress or reveals the session.

event.name: identity
event.description: Sent once after bind. The client cannot choose or change these values.

event.name: output_added

description.summary: a physical output the session may present on

event.description: Geometry is in bsm's global compositor space. scale_120 is the fractional scale times 120 (120 = 1.0). The bridge creates a virtual monitor of this size and scale in Gnoblin and answers with report(output_configured).

event.name: input_state

description.summary: whether bsm routes physical input to this session

event.description: Sent whenever the answer changes. While inactive the session receives no keyboard, pointer or touch events and its surfaces are not shown to any principal other than through bsm's own compositing rules. A background session keeps running; it may throttle rendering but must keep serving its applications.

description.summary: surface of a hosted session on one output

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: Buffers committed before the ack of the latest configure do not count as presented evidence for the reveal gate.

event.name: configure

description.summary: geometry the surface buffer must match

event.description: The attached buffer must be width x height in buffer pixels at the given scale (logical size = pixels * 120 / scale_120).

event.name: presented

description.summary: a buffer was shown to the output

event.description: Only buffers bsm composed for this output. Sent for every commit that reaches the output while the session is visible, and for the first commit after an ack while it is not (as a ready-frame proof, without being shown).
